fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Looses 4 darting slivers of water at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut From the School
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 24 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It can only strike a target that low. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Through the Fingers
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +12% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Wriggled Free
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
